todos.description: Implement missing functions fetch_materials_project, fetch_icsd, fetch_arxiv in scripts/api_client.py, ensuring they return appropriate data or call the PipelineClient.
Implement run_pipeline.py with actual pipeline logic: integrate arxiv_scraper, call DFT calculator, and update candidate materials based on experimental feedback.

Implement dft_calculator.py with actual DFT calculation logic (e.g., using a simple approximation or calling an external tool like VASP/Quantum Espresso via subprocess, or at least a placeholder that returns meaningful results for Tc).
Create data/candidate_scores.json with sample candidate scores for materials like YH10, or update docs/discovery_strategy.md to remove the reference to the missing file.

Unify YH10 Tc values across all files (candidate_materials.md, proposed_chemistry_physics.md, etc.) to a single consistent value (e.g., 250 K or 258 K as per literature).

Also (council-synthesis): Consolidate duplicate candidate_materials.md files (root and any in docs/) into a single authoritative version, resolving inconsistencies in material properties.
Update README.md to replace the coverage badge with a correct one or remove it, and ensure the project description aligns with the directive.
